## Download and run

1. Download **AMT.exe** below (under *Assets*).
2. Double-click it. There is nothing to install, and no Python needed.

**Windows may warn you the first time.** AMT is free and not code-signed, so
Windows SmartScreen can show "Windows protected your PC". Click
**More info → Run anyway**. Some antivirus programs are also suspicious of
any app that listens to the keyboard, which a macro recorder has to do.
If you would rather check first, every release is built automatically from the
public source code, and `AMT.exe.sha256` holds the file's checksum.

Your macros and settings are kept in `Documents\AdvancedMacroTool`, so a
newer version picks them up automatically. (Coming from an older MacroTool
version? Its `Documents\MacroTool` folder is renamed for you on first start.)

The built-in **Help** page explains everything else.
